How do robots interact with humans to create positive emotions? 
In this project you will: 

• Explore how robots can create positive emotions in everyday situations 
• Build and program a robot that interacts with people to create positive emotions 
• Test your program in different situations and record data about your prototype 
• Share your program and ideas
Get inspired by the Design Library base models to build your own solution to this project.
